texts.facts: The present accident claim is based on a detailed accident report (Dar) filed by the police in terms of provisions of Mv Act. 2. The brief facts of the case are that on 27.08.2021 at about 10 AM, petitioner one Sonu Kumar was returning with his 3 years old son namely Priyansh, on his motorcycle HR-51BG-1476 from ESI hospital to his house Shahadpur, Faridabad. When he reached M.B. Road Flyover, a motorcycle Black Splender, bearing no.DL-12SJ-3006 (hereinafter referred to as the offending vehicle) came driven from Sonu Kumar (Dar) vs Jitender (499/21 Bp) on 11 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/67992819/ 1 the wrong side and hit the petitioner and his son. Petitioner clicked the picture of the offending vehicle. The two boys riding the offending bike fled from the spot. Petitioner called 100 number. PCR came and removed the petitioner and his son to AIIMS hospital where petitioner and his son received treatment. On the assurance of the father of the driver of the offending bike, petitioner did not lodge a formal complaint however, as the driver and owner of the offending vehicle did not bear the medical expense of the petitioner and his son, petitioner lodged a complaint with the police regarding the accident on 01.09.2021. 3. On this complaint, an FIR no.0499/21 dated 01.09.2021 was registered u/s 279,338 of IPC & 119 MV Act at PS Badarpur and the matter was investigated. After investigation a charge sheet was filed before concerned criminal court against the driver of the offending vehicle (Respondent no.1) and owner (Respondent no.2) while DAR was filed before this Tribunal. 4. Respondent no.1 is driver and Respondent no.2 is the CHARU GUPTA MACT NO:262/24 Sonu Kumar v. Jitender P.No. 2 Of 15 BK GUPTA Date: 2025.07.11 17:18:58 +0530 owner of offending vehicle. The offending vehicle was uninsured at the time of accident. 5. Despite opportunity, no reply/written statement was filed by Respondents. They were proceeded ex-parte vide order dated 11.09.2024. 6. After completion of pleadings, following issues were framed on 11.09.2024 1. Whether the injured suffered injury in a road traffic accident on 27.08.2021 due to rash and negligent driving of vehicle no. DL-12SJ-3006 being driven by R1 and owned by R-2 (inadvertently mentioned as insured with R-3)? OPP. 2. OPP. 3. Relief. 7. Since this is a case of where the offending vehicle was not insured, respondents were directed vide order dated 12.01.2023 to deposit security amount. Two FDRs of Rs.25,000/- each were deposited by the respondents before learned Ilaka Magistrate and same was deposited by said court before this Tribunal.
